title: Airplane Mode

description.main: John Yuyi's 2021 Dashwood Books zine of nude phone selfies taken in airplane lavatories, from her ongoing Naked Selfie On Airplane project begun in 2018. 20 pages, 15 colour photographs, edition of 300, signed.
description.extended:
The first zine of John Yuyi's Naked Selfie On Airplane project, published by Dashwood Books in 2021 in a signed edition of 300, with fifteen phone selfies taken nude in airplane lavatories.

The series began in 2018 on a sixteen-hour flight from New York to Taipei. Yuyi set herself the rule of taking a naked selfie every time she boarded a plane, in no more time than an ordinary bathroom break. The pictures are full-bleed colour, with no text or design apart from the images. Each shows the mirror, the iPhone, the grey plastic and safety signage of the cabin, and whatever came to hand: a roll of toilet paper tied over her eyes on the cover, a paper seat cover framing her face inside. The zine is part of Dashwood's series on emerging artists, all in the same 20-page, 5.25 by 8 inch format. This copy is signed. A sequel, Airplane Mode 2, followed in 2026.

John Yuyi (b. 1991, Taipei) is a Taiwanese visual artist who lives and works in Taipei and New York. She came to attention in 2015 with Face-Post, temporary tattoos of social media icons applied to her own skin and photographed. Since then she has worked with Gucci and Maison Margiela, shot for Rolling Stone and Pop, and shown at Fotomuseum Winterthur (2021) and Christophe Guye Galerie, Zürich (2022). Her 2023 book In Memory of… was published by Art Paper Editions.
description.artist_bio: John Yuyi (b. 1991, Taipei) is a Taiwanese visual artist working between Taipei and New York; known for Face-Post (2015) temporary social-media tattoos; Forbes 30 Under 30 Asia 2018; Fotomuseum Winterthur 2021; Christophe Guye Galerie 2022.

notes: Dashwood emerging-artist zine series. 15 colour photographs, no text. Out of print at Dashwood. Reviewed by Collector Daily (2021); in Ed Templeton's zines of 2021 for Deadbeat Club. Signed copy. No ISBN.
